query: What recruitment, consent, and retention strategies effectively include diverse older workers and small/medium enterprises in occupational health trials?

response.query: What recruitment, consent, and retention strategies effectively include diverse older workers and small/medium enterprises in occupational health trials?
response.answer: Effective strategies include targeted outreach, flexible recruitment timelines, and incentives for small/medium enterprises. Use community networks and partnerships to engage diverse older workers. Clear communication and transparent trial benefits enhance consent and retention.

results.title: What are Pilot Studies and Clinical Trials?
results.content: What are Pilot Studies and Clinical Trials? What are Pilot Studies and Clinical Trials? Image 5: The University of South Florida and Tampa Fire Rescue conducted a a randomized controlled trial to assess the effectiveness of a worksite exercise regimen targeted to reduce the risk of low back injury and disability in firefighters. One method to improve the design quality and conduct of clinical trials is the use of pilot studies. Pilot studies should test key elements of the trial, including recruitment and retention strategies, intervention delivery, data collection methods and adherence to the study protocol. Pilot studies can determine reasonable tolerances and inform trial procedures to enhance adherence. doi: 10.1016/j.jpsychires., The Role and Interpretation of Pilot Studies in Clinical Research https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3081994/. results.content: Download date:14 Jan 2026 Individual Innovation The Connection Between Leadership and Employees’ Innovative Work Behavior ACADEMISCH PROEFSCHRIFT ter verkrijging van de graad van doctor aan de Universiteit van Amsterdam op gezag van de Rector Magnificus prof. J.J. van Muijen Faculteit Economie en Bedrijfskunde 3 Individual Innovation The Connection Between Leadership and Employees’ Innovative Work Behavior J.P.J. de Jong 4 ISBN 978-90-371-0725-8 EIM Postbus 7001 2701 AA Zoetermeer tel.: 079-343 02 00 jjo@eim.nl Dit onderzoek werd mede mogelijk gemaakt met steun uit het programmaonderzoek MKB en Ondernemerschap. Voor een aantal gedragingen werden onze hypothesen bevestigd: consulteren, delegeren, steun voor innovatie, erkenning, verschaffen van middelen en toewijzing van uitdagende taken bleken positief samen te hangen met innovatief werkgedrag. Vooral de mate waarin medewerkers door hun collega's worden gesteund is van belang, niet alleen voor de leiderschapsgedragingen die direct met innovatief gedrag samenhangen (het verband wordt dan sterker als steun van collega's ontbreekt, en zwakker bij veel steun van collega's), maar ook voor sommige gedragingen die geen direct verband hebben.
